response.overview: A group of young adults travel to a remote farmhouse owned by a frail old man, each arriving with their own personal reason for taking the trip. Despite their differences, they share one goal: to uncover the truth behind the legend of Bigfoot after rumors spread that the creature has been captured somewhere on the property.  What begins as an exciting search for proof quickly spirals into a nightmare. As darkness falls, the group realizes they are no longer alone. One by one, they are hunted by a ruthless killer—but no one knows whether the murderer is a supernatural force tied to the legend or a masked psychopath using the myth as a cover.  With trust fading and the group splitting apart, every decision could be their last. To survive the night, they'll have to uncover the truth before they become the next victims.
response.title: The passanger
